'''Cova Burmooze''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the commissioner of the [[bongo]] racing circuit that gained popularity on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Some time after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], Cova was forced to suspend the racing licenses of [[Neb Neb Goodrow]] and [[Spleed Nukkels]], after they were observed crashing into the bongo of [[Zak Quiglee|Zak "Squidfella" Quiglee]] during the [[Otoh Gunga Challenge]]. The decision was later overturned after Squidfella was brought in for questioning.<ref name="Deep Spoilers" />
